blocks.heading: M.p.ed and UGC NET
rows: Physical education as a school subject (Class 11-12)
CBSE physical education is a 100-mark subject: 70 for theory and 30 for practical. Unit 1 covers careers in physical education, and the practical marks include a fitness test, games skill and yoga.
A A subject, not an entrance test. Graduates from any discipline can apply for B.P.Ed, so you do not need to have studied it.
BPES or B.Sc in physical education (3-year degree)
Example: the Delhi University B.Sc (PE, HE and S) asks for 45% in Class 12 and selects on an entrance test (50%) and a sports skill award (50%).
A route into B.P.Ed and M.P.Ed, and into fitness, sports management and coaching work.

NCTE lengthened it from one year to two in its 2014 regulations. University notices list a graduate in any subject with 50% and some sports participation, or 45% for those who studied physical education. Delhi University selects on a 60-mark written test plus a 40-mark sports skill award.
The teacher-education qualification for PET and school posts. The programme is described as preparing teachers for Classes VI to X.
M.P.Ed (2 years)
College and university roles, senior school posts where a master's is asked for, and the base for UGC NET.
UGC NET, Physical Education (subject code 47)

Coaching-site summaries say a master's in physical education at 55% (50% for reserved categories) is needed. JRF has an age limit of 30, with relaxations. Assistant Professor has no upper age limit. Two papers: 100 marks and 200 marks, no negative marking. Read the current NTA bulletin before you plan, because UGC norms were under revision in 2025.
Eligibility for Assistant Professor posts and the JRF.
B.Ed or D.El.Ed

Teaching degrees for general school subjects. Most physical education notices ask for B.P.Ed. Some states have accepted a 2-year physical education diploma for primary-level physical training posts (the 2025 Punjab notice was reported that way).
Not a substitute for B.P.Ed when the post is physical education. Read each notification's exact qualification line.

blocks.heading: Pay, with the Source and the Catch
rows: Private school PE teacher, entry
About Rs 27,000 to 28,000 a month in one Careers360 article. A university blog lists Rs 2.5 to 4 lakh a year.
Both are secondary, undated compilations. Private school pay varies by city and school.
Fitness instructor, entry
Rs 3 to 6 lakh a year in the same university blog.
Entry-level only, with no survey source. Gym pay depends on certifications and sales targets.
Government school posts

Central school levels under the 7th Pay Commission start at Rs 35,400 (primary teacher), Rs 44,900 (trained graduate teacher) and Rs 47,600 (post-graduate teacher), basic pay before allowances. The 2025 Punjab physical training instructor drive was reported with a starting salary of Rs 29,200 a month.
The central levels show how fixed bands work. Physical education posts sit at different levels in different states. Read the notification for the exact level.
Assistant Professor (college or university)
Entry basic pay of Rs 57,700 at Academic Level 10 under the UGC scales.
Applies to aided and university posts. States and private colleges set their own pay.
SAI senior contract coach
An exceptional, senior outcome that needed years of coaching experience. Not an entry figure.

blocks.heading: Honest Opportunity Cost
rows: Punjab
Based on placing in state-level championships. Read the current rules.
Haryana

A separate 3% quota for eligible sportspersons in Group C posts advertised by the Staff Selection Commission, reported in 2024 for departments including Home, Sports, School Education and Elementary Education.
Only those departments, and only for Group C. Check that year's notice.
Andhra Pradesh
Reported in 2024 as moving from 2% to 3%, with later orders treating it as a 3% horizontal reservation.
Selection can rest on sports achievement and a merit list instead of a written test.
Himachal Pradesh
Appointments of distinguished sportspersons to Class I and II posts are limited to 3% of vacancies.
Aimed at medal-level achievers, not at degree holders.

blocks.heading: Career Options in Physical Education
rows: Government college or university department
Reported at about Rs 8,000 to 50,000 a year. One Chandigarh department example was about Rs 11,500 a year.
For a complete education budget of Rs 6 lakh, two years come to roughly 3% to 17%.
Private college or university
Reported at about Rs 50,000 to 2.5 lakh a year, and up to 3 to 4 lakh at some universities. One university's total was reported as Rs 2 lakh.
On the same Rs 6 lakh budget, two years can be 17% to 80% or more. Above about 20% needs course-specific proof.
Extras: uniform, equipment, practical material
Reported at Rs 15,000 to 25,000 on top.
Count them in, not just the headline fee.

figures.label: Available Job Vacancies
figures.source: No public source we found breaks out how many physical education teacher posts are vacant, so be careful with any page that claims a shortage. Overall school teacher vacancies are large, about 9.8 lakh of 69.9 lakh sanctioned posts in one 2025 analysis, but that is for all subjects and the estimates are disputed. Plan for steady demand, not a guaranteed post.
